description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取基金公司的基础信息列表。可按基金公司代码批量查询，返回基金公司名称、基金公司代码、成立日期、旗下基金数量、资产规模、基金代销类型等数据。当用户想了解某公募基金公司的基本信息、管理规模、旗下有多少只基金时，调用此接口。
description.en: Obtain basic information list for fund companies. Supports batch query by fund company codes, returning fields such as fund company name, fund company code, establishment date, number of funds under management, asset scale, and fund distribution type. Call this interface when users want to understand the basic information of a fund company, its management scale, or how many funds it manages.
